description: Reverse geocoding of a road named by common words only (Carrera 54, Bogota): the address object of the street lies 5.4 km from the road, at its first house. Guards the 15 km box for a common-word query in GeocodingUtilities: with the 5 km box of #26381 the road comes back without street and city.
note: geocoding: the first address of the point as <house>, <street>, <city>
